posts.subject: Ban apologize
posts.bodyHtml:
Hello my name is YoFather.
I was banned from dream community because i was promoting others teamspeak as a joke.
I learned my lesson and i wont do it again , and i also want to say good job to admins doing their job good and fast.


@Luckiris I want to apologize again and im asking you kindly to unban me . i wont do stuff like that again.

Promoting as a joke..... common sense please.


Not only you promoted other ts3 server which in common sense is a ban, but I also have to add that you used to insult me and @WHAT before on ts3 ( I know it's a past but it's not that long ago )



For me the unban should not take place.



Your Sincerely


Michal "OxygeN" J.

Hello @YoFather, nice to see apologies from you !


I decided to not unban you but i will make your ban shorter by two weeks.


I took this decision because you perfectly know how you are acting on servers and on teamspeak so take this time to change your behavior. to admins and players.
